notes: Posted 8 June 2001 with no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (8)': Profit by This or Be Destroyed, Jabba's Palace, Audience Chamber, EPP Han, Prepared Defenses, The Camp, Your Insight Serves You Well and Don't Do That Again; these count toward the 60. The Camp, Your Insight Serves You Well and Don't Do That Again are the starting Effects (Effects, not Defensive Shields, in 2001); none is named as the starting Effect, so none is set.
Posted 'Prepared Defenses' (a Dark starting interrupt) in this Light deck dested Heading For The Medical Frigate, the Light equivalent.
Posted 'EPP Han' appears both in the starting section (imprisoned per the Objective) and under Characters, so the deck has two Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol.

Posted 'Jabba's Palace' dested the Light Special Edition site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'Audience Chamber' the Light Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber; 'Hoth Echo Command Center' Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room); 'Lando with Vibra Axe' Lando With Vibro-Ax; 'Jar Jar' Jar Jar Binks; 'Padme' Padme Naberrie.

Posted 'Nabrun Leads' dested Nabrun Leids; 'Transmission Terminated/Out Of Commision' the combo Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated (the post calls it 'Transmission Terminated/Out Of Commission combo'); 'Sorry about the Mess & Blaster Proficiency' the combo; 'A Jedi's Resilence' A Jedi's Resilience; 'Were You Looking For Me' Were You Looking For Me?; Weapon Levitation the Light Jabba's Palace interrupt.
Posted 'Qui-Gon's Lightsaber' dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (Tatooine; Qui-Gon's Lightsaber is a later Reflections III card).
Total is 62 as published: the Interrupts section is headed (23) but its lines add up to 25. Kept as published.
